entry.title: Bind expected certificate scope to full compilation provenance
entry.why: The expected certificate context authenticates retained input/request/scope, not the complete build context. Discharge: bind the expected certificate context to CompileTaskIdentity, including compiler/target/environment and dependency provenance, and exercise a mismatch. Do not describe the inner digest as full build provenance.

retired.scope: Existing compile-task record and caller-held contract/profile/declared-trust identity; no machine/compiler execution attestation.

entry.title: Bind certificate acceptance to the caller intended contract and trust context
entry.why: Ordinary replay checks the certificate own contract source assumptions. Expected target context does not compare those with a caller-held contract/profile/trust environment. Discharge: a caller-held expected contract/profile/trust identity is compared and a mismatch is exercised.

retired.scope: Existing compile-task record and caller-held contract/profile/declared-trust identity; no machine/compiler execution attestation.

added.title: Publish a checked nominal type for legacy acquisitions
added.why: Legacy qcore_acquire establishes custody without a nominal payload. Explicit own<T> annotations refuse. Discharge: publish the nominal result through a checked operation or callee declaration; the annotation cannot supply its own evidence.

added.title: Connect additional executable annotation surfaces to checked value types
added.why: This wave extends only legacy integer literal annotations; other routes retain exact grammars. Discharge for a widened route requires connecting its established value type to annotation compatibility and adding reference/emission evidence.

added.title: Extend resource calls beyond the closed executable profile
added.why: Direct acyclic resource helpers are not a general resource function type system or separately compiled ABI. Discharge requires checked call boundaries for separately compiled resource functions.

added.title: Prove helper obligations for uncalled and public functions
added.why: The bounded profile requires every helper to be reachable from the selected closed entry. Discharge requires universal argument obligations for uncalled/public helpers rather than closed-entry observations.

added.title: Model resource helper subloans and returned borrows
added.why: Loans cover a whole buffer for one call. Discharge requires checked lifetime/path rules for range subloans, returned/stored loans and relending.

added.title: Add resource helper typed errors and recovery
added.why: Allocation failure has process-exit behavior and refuses surviving ownership. Discharge requires a checked per-error-edge cleanup model for typed errors, recovery and resource payloads.

added.title: Bind resource call extraction and C emission to the formal model
added.why: Lean covers bounded decision rules. Parser extraction, graph flattening and C refinement are review premises. Discharge requires a binding/refinement argument across those boundaries.

retirement_sweep.disposition: The two retired certificate names remain explicitly referenced as discharged in E01-F1-O. The newly unregistered QUIRIN-REVIEW-INTEGRATION is the completed preceding close label, formerly present in the retired entries recorded_by fields, not open work. Annotation residuals now have registered entries; other pre-existing sweep findings are unchanged.
